title: When calling blurs into second-guessing
subtitle: For purpose that loses courage under too many questions
description: These readings bring the rare human chance back into view when doubt starts dissolving the next faithful step.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The gift of human birth is clear enough to require response even when every detail is not settled.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Do the next true thing before doubt demands a complete map.

evidence.coreClaim: This path keeps purpose from being smothered by endless review.
evidence.turn: Doubt becomes smaller when the chance itself is honored with action.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one step that serves meeting, remembrance, or seva, and take it without reopening the whole calling.
